rationale: Harshal is building Xybit, a proprietary trading platform in the crypto space, while Mallikarjuna researches AI and blockchain security at the Institute of Foundational Models — complementary expertise that could strengthen both trading systems and their underlying security infrastructure. With Harshal's conviction that DeFi accessibility requires solving UX and liquidity fragmentation, and Mallikarjuna's depth in ML and blockchain-security research, there's potential to explore how AI/ML could address some of those core barriers.
intro_message: Harshal Madnani, meet Mallikarjuna — you're both working on different sides of crypto infrastructure (trading platforms vs. foundational AI/security research) and could explore how machine learning might solve some of the UX and liquidity challenges Harshal sees as blockers to DeFi adoption.
